notes.title: One Socket Localization Update
notes.notes:
With this new update One Socket can be played in the following 6 additional languages: 

Simplified Chinese (简体中文)

Russian (русский)

Brazilian Portuguese (Português Brasileiro)

Spanish (Español)

German (Deutsch)

French (Français)

If you find any bugs, you can report them in the spreadsheet found on the main menu.

notes.title: Update 0.5.0.9
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where the player would get softlocked when looking at the clock or floor symbols for a extended period of time in level one
 Fixed a bug where the monster in level one would wait longer than intended before attacking
 Added collisions to the bed in the ending level
 Changed color of the podium of the interactable screen in the break room slightly


Thank you everyone who has played One Socket so far! If you find any more bugs you can report them in the form found in the main menu.
